findings.title: Ingress path is a pattern that its pathType compares as text
findings.cause: Ingress web routes path /api/* on shop.example.com with pathType Prefix, which compares paths as text, not as a pattern: only a request for exactly /api/* matches, so the requests meant for it get a 404 or go to another path

evidence.what: the Ingress's paths and their pathType
evidence.command: kubectl get ingress web -n kd-ingress-path-pattern -o jsonpath='{range .spec.rules[*].http.paths[*]}{.path}{" "}{.pathType}{"\n"}{end}'

findings.fix: Use path /api with pathType Prefix, which matches it and everything under it, or pathType ImplementationSpecific with your controller's regular-expression support.
